loops.minute_1: Spawn in the House of Hades, weapon selection (4 choices), preview of boons and unlockables, immediate start of the first room
loops.minute_10: Poursuite dans 3 à 4 salles avec un empilement de 5 à 8 bénédictions (augmentation des dégâts, vitesse et synergies), affrontement du premier mini-boss, choix entre trois options d'amélioration de boons divins
loops.hour_5: Progression à travers 10 chambres ou plus, accumulation de ressources métas (Darkness, Nectar, Ambrosia, Gold), déblocage d'aspects d'arme, application optionnelle du Pact of Punishment pour des récompenses amplifiées
loops.endgame: Final boss confrontation (Hades), likely defeat on first attempts, return to House of Hades hub with meta resource consolidation and narrative unlocks (character dialogues, advanced quests)

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat Hades and escape the Underworld
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches zero without Death Defiance tokens available
objectives.player_goal: Escape the Underworld and reach the surface, while advancing character storylines and unlocking new weapons and abilities

objectives.mode: Solo Campaign - Pact of Punishment (optional challenge modifier)
objectives.victory_condition: Defeat Hades with active Pact modifiers enabled
objectives.defeat_condition: Fail to complete the run without meeting the victory condition
objectives.player_goal: Complete runs under optional difficulty modifiers for greater meta-progression rewards

games.retention_answer: Meta-progression structure makes every death feel like progress: players receive steady streams of permanent upgrades (Darkness currency, weapon unlocks, character abilities) that carry forward, combined with narrative advancement triggered by both success and failure. Death is reframed as a story beat rather than punishment, creating psychological safety and motivation to retry with improved capabilities.

loops.minute_1: Isaac appears on Basement floor 1 with a basic tear, two rooms visible on the procedurally generated map (item room, boss room), first encounters against basic enemies
loops.minute_10: 2-3 rooms traversed, 4-6 items collected stacking effects (amplified tears, damage, attack speed), first boss defeated (Mom's Heart, Monstro), move to floor 2 (Cellar or Caves)
loops.hour_5: 6-8 floors traversed (Basement → Caves → Catacombs → Depths → Womb → Sheol/Cathedral), critical emerging synergies (e.g., Pyromaniac + Mr. Mega), unlocking alternative paths by defeated bosses, access to the Void and secret floors
loops.endgame: Final boss encounter (Mega Satan, Blue Baby, The Lamb, ???), victory grants access to Chest or Dark Room and permanent unlocks (characters, items, alternate floors for future runs), defeat ends the run but consolidates meta-game progression

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat the final boss corresponding to selected route (Sheol/Cathedral/The Chest/The Void)
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches zero with no revival items available
objectives.player_goal: Navigate procedurally-generated dungeon floors, defeat bosses, and reach the exit while discovering powerful item synergies
Unlock new characters, items, and alternate floor paths by achieving specific conditions (defeating bosses with specific characters, finding secret doors, collecting items)

games.retention_answer: Over 700 items create thousands of emergent synergies (many unintended by developers), making every run feel structurally unique. Players return to discover new item combinations and their cascade effects; the chaotic permutation system guarantees fresh mechanical expressions across hundreds of hours. Random floor generation means players can still encounter new room layouts after 500+ hours.

loops.minute_1: Character selection (Ironclad, Silent, Defect), spawn at Act 1 Exordium with starter deck (3 base cards), first path choice between 2-3 room types (combat/shop/rest/event)
loops.minute_10: 3-4 encounters completed, deck expanded with rare cards from choice-nodes, first relics acquired (Burning Blood, Acorn, Scales), gold and potions accumulated, energy system learnt (each card costs energy per turn)
loops.hour_5: Deck construction phase (20-30 cards, synergized relics), Act 1 boss defeated, progression to Act 2 (The City) and Act 3 (The Beyond), difficulty escalation with elite encounters, resource economy tightened (health management, upgrade choices become critical)
loops.endgame: Act 3 final boss encounter (Awakened One, Time Eater, or Donu/Deca), victory triggers meta-unlock progression (keys toward Act 4), permanent ascension level increases reward difficulty scaling, each previous run's victories accumulate toward Act 4 access

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat the Act 3 boss (Awakened One, Time Eater, or Donu/Deca) after path through Acts 1-3
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches zero during any combat encounter
objectives.player_goal: Build a coherent deck through card selection and relic acquisition to defeat a sequence of three bosses across three acts

objectives.victory_condition: Collect three keys (Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald) across separate runs and then defeat Act 3 boss with keys in hand to access Act 4, then defeat Act 4 boss
objectives.player_goal: Unlock and survive the hidden Act 4 encounter, which counts as victory even if health reaches zero in Act 4 (for ascension progression purposes)

games.retention_answer: Infinite procédural decision space: deck-building constraints (energy system, choice-limited picks) × path selection (risk/reward nodes) × relic synergies create millions of unique strategic contexts. Tension between chaos and control (forced randomness mitigated by limited agency) generates psychological engagement. Meta-progression toward Act 4 and Ascension levels promise permanent escalation and new challenges for veteran players.
